text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, try to exercise regularly — even a short walk every day makes a difference. Getting enough sleep is also important, so aim for about eight hours a night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by making time for rest and hobbies. Small daily habits like these can help you feel healthier and happier in the long run.
